title: RS-1 on Cambie near King Edward: 10 → 20 Storeys
narrative: A classic single-family lot on Cambie Street, 600 sqm, zoned RS-1 with FSR 0.6. Under Bill 47, proximity to King Edward SkyTrain station unlocks Tier 1 entitlement — up to 20 storeys and 5.5 FSR. This represents one of the largest density uplifts in the city.

title: Marpole RS-1 near Marine Drive Station
narrative: A 750 sqm single-family lot in Marpole, assessed at $2.1M. Marine Drive SkyTrain station is within walking distance, unlocking Tier 1 Bill 47 entitlements. The low current FSR of 0.6 means the density uplift creates substantial buildable area — an ideal small-developer opportunity.

title: Commercial C-3A on Granville: Already Zoned Higher
narrative: This 1,800 sqm commercial site on Granville Street is already zoned C-3A with FSR 3.0 and 30-storey height. Bill 47 Tier 1 only allows 20 storeys and 5.5 FSR — the existing zoning already exceeds the Bill 47 entitlement. Demonstrates that not every TOA parcel is an opportunity.

title: Renfrew RS-1: Edge of TOA, Tier 3 Marginal
narrative: A small 500 sqm lot on Renfrew Street, assessed at $1.7M. Sitting at the outer edge of the Transit-Oriented Area (400–800m from the station), it qualifies for only Tier 3: 8 storeys and 3.0 FSR. The uplift is real but modest — representing the lower end of Bill 47 opportunities.

title: 12,000 sqm Industrial: Highest Absolute Buildable SF
narrative: The largest lot in this area at 12,000 sqm, this Renfrew-Collingwood industrial parcel creates the highest absolute buildable square footage under Bill 47. Even a modest FSR uplift on this lot generates enormous development potential — but the scale also means higher execution complexity and capital requirements.
